# Compute cheapest product per product_type in cart and determine which to buy vs move to wish list
cart_items = cart_resp['cart_items']
product_info_by_id = locals().get('product_info_by_id', {})

from collections import defaultdict
items_by_type = defaultdict(list)
for ci in cart_items:
    pid = ci['product_id']
    ptype = product_info_by_id[pid].get('product_type')
    items_by_type[ptype].append(ci)

cheapest_by_type = {}
for ptype, items in items_by_type.items():
    min_price = min(i['price'] for i in items)
    cheapest_items = [i for i in items if i['price'] == min_price]
    cheapest_by_type[ptype] = {
        'min_price': min_price,
        'buy_product_ids': [i['product_id'] for i in cheapest_items],
        'move_product_ids': [i['product_id'] for i in items if i['product_id'] not in [c['product_id'] for c in cheapest_items]]
    }

print('product_types:', list(items_by_type.keys()))
print('cheapest_by_type:', cheapest_by_type)

buy_product_ids = []
move_product_ids = []
move_quantity_by_pid = {}
for ptype, info in cheapest_by_type.items():
    buy_product_ids.extend(info['buy_product_ids'])
    # move items and quantities
    for ci in items_by_type[ptype]:
        if ci['product_id'] in info['move_product_ids']:
            move_product_ids.append(ci['product_id'])
            move_quantity_by_pid[ci['product_id']] = ci['quantity']

print('buy_product_ids:', buy_product_ids)
print('move_product_ids:', move_product_ids)
print('move_quantity_by_pid:', move_quantity_by_pid)

move_product_ids = [779, 781, 783, 1302, 1310, 2431, 2432]
move_quantity_by_pid = {779: 1, 781: 1, 783: 1, 1302: 1, 1310: 1, 2431: 1, 2432: 1}

move_results = []
for pid in move_product_ids:
    qty = move_quantity_by_pid[pid]
    resp = apis.amazon.move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list(product_id=pid, access_token=amazon_token, quantity=qty)
    move_results.append({'product_id': pid, 'quantity': qty, 'resp': resp})

print(move_results)

# Verification: check updated cart and wish list
updated_cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
updated_wishlist = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token)

print('updated_cart_items:', len(updated_cart['cart_items']))
print('updated_cart_product_ids:', [ci['product_id'] for ci in updated_cart['cart_items']])
print('updated_wishlist_items:', len(updated_wishlist))
print('updated_wishlist_product_ids_sample:', [wi['product_id'] for wi in updated_wishlist])

# Map product types using previously fetched product_info_by_id
orig_types = sorted(list(items_by_type.keys()))
print('orig_types:', orig_types)

# Determine which original product ids should remain in cart
# Build expected sets from earlier computation
expected_buy_product_ids = set(buy_product_ids)
expected_move_product_ids = set(move_product_ids)

remaining_cart_ids = set(ci['product_id'] for ci in updated_cart['cart_items'])
wishlist_ids = set(wi['product_id'] for wi in updated_wishlist)

print('expected_buy_product_ids:', sorted(expected_buy_product_ids))
print('expected_move_product_ids:', sorted(expected_move_product_ids))
print('remaining_cart_ids:', sorted(remaining_cart_ids))
print('wishlist_ids:', sorted(wishlist_ids))

print('cart_contains_only_expected_buy:', remaining_cart_ids.issubset(expected_buy_product_ids))
print('cart_missing_expected_buy:', expected_buy_product_ids - remaining_cart_ids)
print('wishlist_missing_expected_move:', expected_move_product_ids - wishlist_ids)
